caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned vase. The vase is rendered in shades of purple, with gradations that suggest a glossy, reflective surface. Its form is symmetrical, featuring a wide, flattened rim at the top that narrows at the neck before expanding into a bulbous, rounded body. The body of the vase displays elongated, vertical, rounded segments or panels, each shaded to emphasize the curvature and three-dimensional structure. There are no other objects or decorative elements present, and the background is plain, light beige or off-white, with no discernible pattern. The artist's signature, "I. STEINBERG," appears toward the bottom left of the image.
title: Vase
